Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 2
, Reason for Mistake: In Step 2, the Planner incorrectly interpreted the Wikipedia information. The Wikipedia page explicitly states that the paternal grandparents of the 2nd Earl were "Sir Arthur Gore, 2nd Baronet" and "Elizabeth Annesley". The Planner erroneously concluded that this meant the grandfather was the "2nd Baronet" while simultaneously acknowledging the father was the "1st Earl". This creates a logical impossibility in the lineage chain (2nd Earl -> 1st Earl -> 2nd Baronet) because the 1st Earl of Arran was created in 1762, whereas the 2nd Baronet died in 1741/42. The 2nd Baronet is actually the grandfather, and the 1st Earl is the father. The Planner's confusion led to redundant and confusing search instructions in subsequent steps, failing to correctly identify the simple lineage presented in the first source.
